visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair appears in a close-up, wearing a thick grey fur-lined beanie and a black and grey patterned scarf. Her nose is slightly red, and her eyes look watery as she looks around a grassy, windswept mountain slope. The lighting is overcast and flat. (2) The scene shifts to a bright, sunlit landscape featuring a green, pointed mountain peak with white clouds swirling around its summit. The camera pans across the ridge. (3) An older woman in a plaid shirt and blue pants and a young girl in a grey sweater and red cap are seen from behind, walking up a lush green trail. (4) A wide shot shows a person walking along a rocky mountain ridge under a clear blue sky, with distant blue mountain ranges in the background. (5) A young man in a black hoodie and a young woman in black activewear stand atop a rocky outcrop. The man holds a smartphone, and the woman shades her eyes while looking at the horizon. (6) A handheld shot follows the woman from behind as she walks through a narrow trail lined with tall green grass and bamboo. (7) An aerial drone shot captures a winding road snaking through the green mountain peaks, leading to a small building complex nestled in a saddle between ridges. (8) Detailed shots of a wooden boardwalk and a narrow dirt path with rocks follow. (9) A group of school children wearing colorful backpacks and hats are seen climbing a steep set of stairs on a grassy hillside. (10) The woman runs joyfully along a high-altitude grassy ridge, her arms spread wide against the backdrop of massive mountain peaks. (11) A fast-paced montage shows a thick sea of white clouds in a valley, followed by a bright sunrise casting a lens flare. (12) The woman sits on a rock ledge, gazing out at the vast green landscape and winding mountain roads. (13) A top-down drone shot shows two people lying on a green grassy patch next to a path, one person wearing blue jeans and the other in black leggings. (14) The woman stands behind a silver metallic sign that reads '石門山 Mt. Shihmen' at the summit. (15) Close-up shot of a small brown and white bird with yellow highlights on its wings pecking at the ground. (16) The woman walks along a paved road with yellow guardrails and mountain road signs, spinning around with a smile. (17) A final shot shows her eating from a small orange bowl with a wooden skewer, followed by a scenic view of her looking at snowy or grey rocky peaks.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 male companion at the summit, 1 elderly woman, 1 child hiking, and a group of approximately 10 school children on the stairs.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long dark hair, wearing various outfits: a black and grey patterned scarf with a grey fur beanie, a grey long-sleeved shirt with a black vest, and a black puffy jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: High-altitude alpine scenery in Taiwan, specifically Mt. Shihmen. Features include grassy slopes (Yushan Cane), rocky ridges, winding mountain roads (Hehuanshan highway), sea of clouds, and a sunrise. Some shots show wooden boardwalks and paved roads with traffic signs.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with a high-energy, friendly tone, exclaiming 'Lěng sǐle!' (Freezing to death!). The background music is an upbeat acoustic guitar track with a steady, driving drum beat at approximately 124 BPM. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs. The narrator explains the 'natural air conditioning' of the mountains in summer. (3) A percussive 'click' SFX accompanies a scene shift as the narrator highlights the ease of the climb. The BGM maintains a consistent, joyful energy. (4) The narrator continues with rapid-fire delivery, detailing the 30-minute hike and elevation. High-frequency digital 'pop' SFX are used periodically to mark text appearing on screen. (5) A bird chirping sound is briefly layered over the music. The narrator's voice remains bright and enunciated. (6) Another 'whoosh' transition occurs as the narration shifts to recommending the trail for beginners. The BGM volume ducks slightly to prioritize the clear vocal track. (7) The video concludes with a closing slogan and a call to action, ending on a final chord from the guitar and a gentle fade in the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Information -> Scenery Montage -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Mt. Shihmen in Taiwan as an accessible and rewarding high-altitude hiking destination for beginners, families, and even children. It uses vibrant visuals, energetic narration, and practical information (time, altitude) to lower the barrier for viewers considering their first 'Baiyue' (top 100 peaks) challenge.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality travel vlog with professional drone shots and social-media style fast editing. The contrast between the initial 'cold' close-up and the subsequent lush summer greenery creates an effective hook.
